# Keeno

> Keeno is a compiled, signal-based frontend framework. Components are `.kn` files with HTML-first JSX markup, a `<script>` block and a scoped `<style>` block. The compiler (via `@inflector/vite-plugin-keeno`) turns them into direct DOM code with fine-grained updates: no virtual DOM, no re-rendering components. Tooling is Bun (packages, scripts, `bun test`) plus Vite.

Rules that differ from React, Svelte and Vue, which models get wrong most often:

- **Reading state:** in `.kn` files, read a local state by name (`count`), not `count()` or `count.value`. Write with `count.set(v)`, never `count = v`.
- **Reserved members:** `x.set`, `x.get`, `x.peek`, `x.onUpdate`, `x.undo`, `x.redo`, `x.canUndo` and `x.canRedo` stay on the state. Any other member (`x.length`, `x.map`) reads the value.
- **Immutable updates:** `todos.set([...todos, item])`. In-place mutation (`todos.push`) does not update anything.
- **Computed values:** use `derived(() => …)`. Don't copy values between states in `update()`.
- **Shared stores:** in plain `.ts` files, states are plain objects (`s.get()`, `s.set()`), and imported stores stay that way in components.
- **Props:** `const { a, b = 1 } = props()` stays reactive. No `...rest`; use `const p = props()` instead.
- **Markup:** `class`, not `className` (both work). Use `onClick={fn}`, not `@click` or `on:click`. Two-way binding is `bind:value={state}`.
- **Lists:** `{list.map(item => <li key={item.id}>…</li>)}` is keyed. The callback must return JSX directly.
- **Lifecycle:** `init(fn)` runs after mount and its return value is cleanup. `update(fn)` runs when a value read inside `fn` changes (deps inferred by the compiler), and `update(fn, [a, b])` only when `a` or `b` changes; neither runs on mount. `destroy(fn)` runs on unmount.
- **State options:** `persist`, `url`, `history`, `equals`, `validate`, `debounce` and `throttle`.
- **Built-ins:** `ErrorBoundary`, `Await`, `Dynamic`, `Portal`, `Transition`, `lazy()` and `reparentable()` are imported from `@inflector/keeno`. Render props such as `fallback={(error, reset) => <p>…</p>}` and `fulfilled={(value) => …}` are functions.
- **Reparenting:** to move content between places without re-creating it, `const player = reparentable(() => <Video />)` and render `{player}` wherever it should be now. Use `keyedReparentable((id) => <Card id={id} />)` for items moving between lists. Imperatively: `player.moveTo(el)`, `player.remove()`, and `moveNode(node, parent)` for any DOM node.
- **Context:** `provide(Ctx, value)` and `inject(Ctx)` are called in `<script>`. To make the value reactive, provide a state. An injected state is a plain object, so use `.get()`.
- **Packages:** `@inflector/keeno` (runtime), `@inflector/keeno/server` (`renderToString`), `@inflector/keeno-router`, `@inflector/vite-plugin-keeno` and `@inflector/keeno-check`.

## Docs

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): setup with Bun and Vite, a first component, mounting
- [Components](docs/components.md): script, markup and style; props, children, lifecycle, mount
- [Reactivity](docs/reactivity.md): state read and write rules, derived, async derived (`<Loading>`, `pending()`, `refresh()`), update vs onUpdate, shared states, `store()` (deep mutable data, `snapshot`, `reconcile`), batching
- [State options](docs/state-options.md): persist, url, history (undo/redo), equals, validate, debounce, throttle
- [Templates](docs/templates.md): expressions, conditionals, keyed lists, events, bind, class arrays, spread
- [Directives](docs/directives.md): `use:name={value}` reusable DOM behaviors: writing them, reactive values, cleanup, type checking
- [Styles](docs/styles.md): scoped CSS, `:global()`, Tailwind CSS (`@apply` in `<style>`, auto `@reference`)
- [Context](docs/context.md): createContext, provide and inject
- [Built-in components](docs/built-ins.md): ErrorBoundary, Loading, Await, lazy, Dynamic, Portal, reparentable, Transition
- [Routing](docs/routing.md): @inflector/keeno-router: Router, Link, navigate, useRoute, View Transitions
- [File-based routing](docs/file-routing.md): src/pages routes with the Vite plugin: layouts, 404/500 pages, httpError, virtual:keeno-pages
- [Server rendering](docs/ssr.md): renderToString (waits for async deriveds and sends their values), renderToStream (streams `<Loading>` boundaries), hydrate, Vite SSR setup
- [Security](docs/security.md): what is escaped, innerHTML, javascript: URLs, CSP
- [Tooling](docs/tooling.md): Vite plugin, HMR, dev mode, VS Code extension, keeno-check, testing with `bun test`
- [API reference](docs/api.md): every export, and the compile rules in one table
- [Versioning and support](docs/stability.md): semver policy, public API, supported browsers, Node and Vite versions
